## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow sector breadth with Materials/Healthcare/Utilities positive while Big Tech is broadly BELOW TREND, and Leadership: Broad (Top 5 performers span 5 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: DD (1W: +183.93% | 1M: +192.30%) ABOVE TREND and sector outperformance 1W: +13.04%. Healthcare showing strength: ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND and DHR (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities positive on the week (1W: +1.64%) at the sector level.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging with widespread weakness: AAPL (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; Tech 1W: -3.96%. Energy and Communication also weak on the week (Energy 1W: -2.55%, Communication 1W: -2.26%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD (1W: +183.93% | 1M: +192.30%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.14% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LMT (1W: -8.27% | 1M: -7.20%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -18.92%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -17.58%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -20.04%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -11.85% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Materials and select Industrials/Financials but is broadly distributed.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: DD (1W: +183.93%), INTC (1W: +12.47%), WMB (1W: +6.14%), TGT (1W: +5.85%), CAT (1W: +5.18%). Watch divergences: several names (WMB, MRK) are RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) — tactical bounces, not full trend confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is weak and broad: AAPL (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: -3.96% (24 stocks). Technology shows breadth weakness and is not leading.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed within Financials: JPM (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND while sector 1W: -0.97% and 1M: +3.90%; monitor for divergence between bank leaders and broader financial weakness. Style: no clear shift to Value yet.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare modestly positive: ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY; Sector 1W: +0.50% (17 stocks). Defensive characteristics are present but mixed signals exist.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to cyclical leaders showing confirmed strength (DD, CAT, GE) and healthcare names (ABBV, DHR); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing consistent BELOW TREND behavior (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Style mixed — remain selective and monitor follow-through on RECOVERY names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DD (1W: +183.93% | 1M: +192.30%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +13.02%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NFLX (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -18.92%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -21.97% | 1M: -27.95%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +13.04%) and Healthcare (1W: +0.50%) given concentrated strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.96%) and Energy (1W: -2.55%) as broad weakness persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
DD: monitor consolidation above recent spike (1W: +183.93% | 1M: +192.30%) for trend confirmation; NVDA: watch for failure below recent support (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) as tech risk signal; JPM: watch continuation above monthly momentum (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +8.84%) to validate financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MRK (+75): MRK (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY — vaccine approval headlines; price action is a short-term bounce (sentiment confirming 1W strength but 1M weakness). LMT (+65): LMT (1W: -8.27% | 1M: -7.20%) BELOW TREND — large contract news but price falling (sentiment diverging, distribution). JPM (+55): JPM (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND — dividend/buyback headlines confirming strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-60): PFE (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -7.18%) BELOW TREND — trial disappointment and price decline confirm downside. NVDA (-50): NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — partnership headlines but price falling, divergence implies distribution. ACN (-50): ACN (1W: -21.97% | 1M: -27.95%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and steep price decline confirm bearish sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Materials and select Healthcare names are showing relative strength (DD ABOVE TREND, ABBV ABOVE TREND, CAT ABOVE TREND) while Big Tech is broadly BELOW TREND. Key risk: narrow market breadth with Tech below trend and several sentiment-price divergences (LMT, NVDA) — monitor for confirmation before adding risk.
